# Ashi's Frozen Goods

> Ashi's Frozen Goods is a specialty frozen seafood shop in Pavia, Iloilo. It sells GenSan tuna, salmon, sashimi, and imported steaks for households and food businesses. Customers can visit the shop to pick up or send an order on Messenger.

## Pages

- [Home](https://ashifrozengoods.com/): Shop overview, Maxim delivery, customer reviews, and how to order.
- [Menu](https://ashifrozengoods.com/menu/): Photo-and-price list for tuna, processed tuna, salmon, and imported steaks.
- [About](https://ashifrozengoods.com/about/): What the shop sells, the shop background, and how to buy.
- [Contact](https://ashifrozengoods.com/contact/): Address, hours, phone, email, map, and Messenger.

## Key facts

- Sold: GenSan tuna, including panga, sashimi, saku, and steaks, plus processed tuna favorites. Salmon sashimi, loin, steaks, fillets, and belly. Imported USDA, Brazilian, Australian, and Japanese wagyu steak cuts.
- Location: Door 4, AC Arcade Building, Felix Gorriceta Jr. Avenue, Pavia, 5001 Iloilo, in Brgy. Pandac. Open daily from 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM.
- Order: Message the shop on Messenger at https://m.me/ashifrozengoods, or visit the shop to pick up.
- Phone: 0945-962-2304
- Email: ashifrozengoods@gmail.com
- Delivery: The shop will book Maxim. Send the delivery address. A screenshot of the pinned location is preferred. A delivery fee applies, based on the Maxim quote for that trip.
